def blk(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and 10<=n['boundary'][0][0]<=45:
            d[n['color']]=(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))
    rope=[max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='w' and 15<=n['boundary'][0][0]<=45 and n['pixels']<=4]
    pr=[(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']<40]
    return d,(max(rope) if rope else None),pr
print("before:", blk(previous_frame))
r=action(['DOWN'])
print("after :", blk(current_frame))
print("changed:", r['board_changed'], r.get('gameplay_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>

def blk(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
